# Typology Central

> > A community forum exploring MBTI, Enneagram, and Keirsey personality theory through discussion, type analysis, and philosophical inquiry.

Typology Central is a personality typology discussion forum where members analyze MBTI types (INTJ, INTP, ENTJ, ISTP, etc.), debate type theory frameworks, type fictional characters, and explore connections between personality, philosophy, religion, and human behavior. The community combines practical type identification with deeper theoretical and existential discussions.

## Key Topics

- MBTI (Myers-Briggs Type Indicator)
- Enneagram
- Keirsey Temperament Theory
- INTJ, INTP, ENTJ, ISTP personality types
- Type identification and assessment
- Character typing (fictional characters)
- Personality theory frameworks
- Philosophy and rationalism
- Type-based behavior patterns
- Gender and type bias
- Temperament correlations
- Cognitive functions
- Type descriptions and comparisons

## Type Theory and Frameworks

- [Differences in type descriptions](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/differences-in-type-descriptions.654): Comparison of Keirsey vs MBTI type descriptions for INFP and ENTJ
- [MBTI & Co-relation wt. Keirsey 4 Temperaments](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/mbti-co-relation-wt-keirsey-4-temperaments.694): HR professional's inquiry on MBTI vs Keirsey temperament correlations
- [Gender Bias in Type Identification / Interrelating](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/gender-bias-in-type-identification-interrelating.611): Discussion on gender bias, transgender issues in MBTI type identification
- [How did you find out your type?](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/how-did-you-find-out-your-type.834): Community discussion on MBTI discovery via Humanmetrics and other tests

## Type-Specific Forums

- [The SP Arthouse (ESFP, ISFP, ESTP, ISTP)](https://www.typologycentral.com/forums/the-sp-arthouse-esfp-isfp-estp-istp.23): Forum section dedicated to SP personality types (ESFP, ISFP, ESTP, ISTP)
- [[NT] - Sensory stuff you find oddly enjoyable](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/sensory-stuff-you-find-oddly-enjoyable.186): NT forum discussion on sensory experiences and preferences

## Personality and Behavior Analysis

- [Survival Games Personalities Play](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/survival-games-personalities-play.1052): Discussion on personality types under stress and unmet needs
- [Types and Revenge](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/types-and-revenge.769): Analysis of revenge behavior patterns across MBTI personality types
- [Which types REALLY make the best cops?](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/which-types-really-make-the-best-cops.768): Discussion on MBTI types suited for police and detective work

## Character Typing

- [MBTI appeal of Death Note anime?](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/mbti-appeal-of-death-note-anime.190): MBTI analysis of Death Note anime appeal to INTJ, ENFP, INTP types
- [Type the Star Trek Characters](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/type-the-star-trek-characters.1262): MBTI typing of Star Trek TNG, Voyager, and TOS characters

## Philosophy and Ideas

- [Justificationism](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/justificationism.1075): Philosophical essay on justificationism and epistemology
- [My Religion](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/my-religion.169): Personal essay on religion, rationalism, and Christianity by INTP member
- [Nature is Round, and Humans are Square](https://www.typologycentral.com/threads/nature-is-round-and-humans-are-square.397): Philosophical observation on natural vs human-made geometric shapes
